h11.

**1st: `User` (`store.User`, defined in `store/user.go:29`)** — referenced from roughly 6 packages outside `store/`: `server/auth` (session/token handling), `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1` (the main gRPC/Connect API layer), `server/router/api/v1/test` (test helpers), `server/router/fileserver` (avatar serving), and `server/router/rss`.

**2nd: `Memo` (`store.Memo`, defined in `store/memo.go:35`)** — referenced from roughly 4 packages outside `store/`: `server/router/api/v1`, `server/notification`, `server/router/rss`, and `server/runner/memopayload`.

For comparison, other persistent entity types have narrower reach: `Attachment` (~3 packages: `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/runner/s3presign`), `Inbox`/`MemoShare` (~2 each), and `Reaction`, `MemoRelation`, `UserIdentity`, `UserSetting`, `IdentityProvider`, `InstanceSetting` (1 each) — all well behind `User` and `Memo`. This was determined via a repo-wide search for `store.<Type>` usages across non-test `.go` files, grouped by containing directory (package).
